# Two ways USD arrives without an invoice, each establishing its own cost basis:
# bought with CAD at 1.35, and borrowed at 1.30.
#
# Each arriving split states its own guid — `0d0d…0135` for the dollars bought
# and `0d0d…0130` for the dollars borrowed — so a file layered on this book can
# say which of the two a disposal came out of without being handed the guid at
# run time. The two cost 135.00 and 130.00 CAD, so which one is given decides
# the gain, which is why nothing picks for the reader.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Loan
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0135"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"

2026-01-20 * "Borrow 100 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0d0130"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.30"
		value: "130.00"
	Liabilities:Loan -130.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-130.00"
